contribution: An explicit elementary collapse on the Alexander dual and the integral wedge types of both complexes. The face lattice and signed Euler count, including the hexagon term, are prior results.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs with n>=10 and girth at least six, ordinary five-cuts only. No shellability, equivariant classification or smaller-order assertion. Finite checks are corroboration, not formal verification.
title: Integral homotopy types of ordinary five-cut complexes at the hexagonal girth boundary
